title: Identity and composition laws for a normalized tensor family
statement:
theorem podReindexingTensorFamilyIdentityComposition
    (completion : ∀ {V W : Scheme.{u}} (f : V ⟶ W) [IsIso f]
      [∀ v : V, Invertible (l : V.residueField v)]
      [∀ w : W, Invertible (l : W.residueField w)], PodCompletionReindex l E f)
    (tensor : ∀ {V W : Scheme.{u}} (f : V ⟶ W) [IsIso f]
      [∀ v : V, Invertible (l : V.residueField v)]
      [∀ w : W, Invertible (l : W.residueField w)],
      PodCompletedTensorReindex l E f (completion f))
    (hcompletion : ∀ {V W : Scheme.{u}} (f : V ⟶ W) [IsIso f]
      [∀ v : V, Invertible (l : V.residueField v)]
      [∀ w : W, Invertible (l : W.residueField w)],
      PodCompletionReindex.Laws l E f (completion f))
    (htensor : ∀ {V W : Scheme.{u}} (f : V ⟶ W) [IsIso f]
      [∀ v : V, Invertible (l : V.residueField v)]
      [∀ w : W, Invertible (l : W.residueField w)],
      PodCompletedTensorReindex.Laws l E f (completion f) (tensor f)) :
    ∃ identity : ∀ W : Scheme.{u}, isoReductionIntegralInverse l E (𝟙 W) ≅ 𝟭 _,
    ∃ composition : ∀ {V W Z : Scheme.{u}} (h : Z ⟶ W) (f : W ⟶ V)
      [IsIso h] [IsIso f], isoReductionIntegralInverse l E (h ≫ f) ≅
        isoReductionIntegralInverse l E f ⋙ isoReductionIntegralInverse l E h,
      let A : PodReindexFamily l E := ⟨completion, tensor, identity, composition⟩
      A.Relabelling l E ∧ A.Identity l E ∧ A.Composition l E

source.place: Steps 1 and 5: section-normalized identity and compositor construction.

proof.text: Use constant-section uniqueness to identify the constant coefficient identity and compositor. Joint monicity of the inverse-limit projections identifies the completed coefficient comparisons. Apply Mathlib pushforwardNatIso, pushforwardCongr, pushforwardId and pushforwardComp to construct module natural isomorphisms, and compute their components to prove both Relabelling formulas. These constructions require no unproved choice of module data.
Apply the separate identity and composition compatibility theorems to this fixed family and its two proved section formulas, and assemble the three conjunctions.

proof_origin.place: Steps 1 and 5: identity and composition of the normalized quotient, Roos-limit and tensor transport.
